body:
Evidence (t_01a185278fad9367, 2026-10-29 01:07Z): all 9 hermes-hub runners busy, 56 hermes-hub jobs queued (6x tests 1/2, 9x tests 2/2); PR #180 (t_01a184bf9b541962) and PR #181 test jobs waiting since ~23:19Z. gen-3 i-0e005dfbadb163293 and gen-4 i-0956308211c3874cf (c6a.4xlarge, us-west-2) are idle but SPOT, and the hermes-hub label was withdrawn 2026-10-28 because spot ACPI stops kill 15-40 min test shards (pinned by test_long_job_labels_stay_off_spot_boxes). No free action fixes the queue.

Ask: convert both hosts to on-demand (relaunch as on-demand c6a.4xlarge from the same image), update slots-gw-gen3.json / slots-gw-gen4.json to on-demand + hermes-hub, and re-add the hermes-hub label via ci-slice converge. Cost: on-demand c6a.4xlarge is about $0.61/h (about $440/month each, so about $880/month for both, roughly $500/month more than spot today).

Unblock (yes) = do the conversion, verify via DescribeInstances InstanceLifecycle absent, labels restored, and a queued Python test shard starts on gen-3/gen-4 within 10 min. Archive (no) = keep spot; the queue drains on its own over several hours.

human_request.action: Approve or decline converting CI hosts gen-3 and gen-4 from spot to on-demand c6a.4xlarge (about +$500/month) to restore 6 hermes-hub runner slots.
human_request.evidence: t_01a185278fad9367 capacity-decision.md: 9/9 hermes-hub runners busy, 56 jobs queued at 01:07Z; gen-3/gen-4 idle but spot (DescribeInstances), label withdrawn 2026-10-28 for spot ACPI stops.
human_request.scope: Two EC2 instances i-0e005dfbadb163293, i-0956308211c3874cf; their slot tables and runner labels only.
human_request.why_human: Recurring spend above the agent's standing approvals.

title: Decide: switch CI hosts gen-3/gen-4 from spot to on-demand to restore 6 hermes-hub runner slots?
